home.styleSectionSubtitle: Style your wishlist exactly how you want it.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Create, share, and manage your wishlists for any occasion — it's free!
home.howItWorksStep1Desc: Make wishlists for birthdays, Christmas, weddings, or any occasion. Add items from Amazon, Target, Etsy, and any online store with our universal wishlist maker.
home.howItWorksStep2Desc: Track prices, get sale notifications, and organize your wishes by priority. Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop — sync across all devices.
home.howItWorksStep3Desc: Send your wishlist to family and friends with a simple link. They can see what's available and mark items as purchased to avoid duplicates.
home.createAnyWishlistSubtitle: From special occasions to everyday shopping, we've got you covered
home.testimonialsTitle: Loved by millions of happy users
home.testimonialsSubtitle: See what our users have to say about their experience with Weesh
home.testimonial1Quote: We used Weesh for our wedding registry. Guests could see exactly what we wanted with links — no more wrong sizes or duplicates. Made everything so much easier for us and for them.
home.testimonial2Quote: My family lives in another country. For the baby shower they could still shop from my list because everything had links. Felt like they were right there. So grateful for this.
home.testimonial3Quote: Finally an app that does one thing and does it well. No bloat, no ads. I keep a list for myself and share one with my partner. Simple and it just works.
home.testimonial4Quote: Every Christmas we had duplicate gifts because nobody knew what others were buying. This year we all shared our Weesh links — problem solved. Best holiday in years.
home.testimonial5Quote: I move a lot so my family is spread everywhere. One link for my birthday list, they don't need to sign up, and I can update it anytime. Game changer for staying connected.
home.testimonial6Quote: I have separate lists for my birthday, housewarming, and travel gear. Same link for each, I just update the items. No more sending new links every time. Brilliant.
home.pricingSubtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you need more.
